top_signals.title: Gold Advances as Traders Watch US Inflation for Rate-Hike Clues
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher, as traders weighed prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz while awaiting US inflation data that could provide fresh clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
